about: Shared cases for round 35, written by the browser simulation. The Windows app must give the same answers.

items: The tray menu is shorter: Lookup, Today, Review a draft, Ask, More, Settings and Help. With all tools on, Lists holds the two to-do lists, the notes and your usage. More holds the rest; Help holds first steps and what changed.
Text in the Windows app uses one scale of six sizes, so pages read calmer and larger text grows them together.
